ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 80% high-intensity white/light-grey ventral surface bounded by approximately 20% low-intensity black perimeter and median pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve along the trailing edges tapering upward toward the lateral tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular gouge or missing tissue segment on the far lateral left trailing edge; significant vertical scarring/pigmentation at the fluke center.
